# Dilan Kochhar

> Web developer and AI engineer serving Tampa Bay, Miami, and New York. Designs and builds websites, apps, and AI agents solo, and offers CRM management from $1,500/month (pipeline setup, automations, follow-ups, and reporting). Also offers website care plans: security $45/month, maintenance $80/month, or both as Full Care for $100/month. Websites are one-time builds starting at $1,000. Founder of Dilly (trydilly.com), an iPhone and iPad app where kids learn how AI works by teaching their own companion.

## Services

- [Services & pricing](https://dilankochhar.com/#services): CRM management from $1,500/month. Website care plans from $45/month (security, maintenance, or both). Websites are one-time builds from $1,000; apps and AI agents scoped per project.
